title: keep short
rule: Keep the form short: remove fields that can be derived, collected later, or omitted.
pass_when: Asked fields are needed now; derivable, deferrable, or omitable data is not on this form.
fail_when: The form asks for unused-now, already-known, or computable data.
overview: Ask only what is needed now; drop derived, deferrable, or omitable fields.
apply_when: Editing form length and which fields appear on this step.
not_when: Regulatory or safety fields that must be collected now.
agent_hint: Remove fields that can be derived, deferred, or omitted from this form.
description: Keep the form short: remove fields that can be derived, collected later, or omitted. Pass when asked fields are needed now and derivable, deferrable, or omitable data is not on this form; fail when the form asks for unused-now, already-known, or computable data. Shorter forms lower drop-off without inventing which legal fields may be skipped.
